mapper.insert: insert into material_stock_allocation_item (allocation_id, stock_id, material_id, storage_address, allocate_qty, locked_qty, outbound_qty, released_qty, sort_no, status, is_del, create_time, update_time) values (#{allocationId}, #{stockId}, #{materialId}, #{storageAddress}, #{allocateQty}, #{lockedQty}, #{outboundQty}, #{releasedQty}, #{sortNo}, #{status}, #{isDel}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, allocation_id, stock_id, material_id, storage_address, allocate_qty, locked_qty, outbound_qty, released_qty, sort_no, status, is_del, create_time, update_time from material_stock_allocation_item where id = #{id} and is_del = 0

select id, allocation_id, stock_id, material_id, storage_address, allocate_qty, locked_qty, outbound_qty, released_qty, sort_no, status, is_del, create_time, update_time from material_stock_allocation_item where allocation_id = #{allocationId} and is_del = 0 order by sort_no asc, id asc
mapper.update: update material_stock_allocation_item set locked_qty = #{lockedQty}, outbound_qty = #{outboundQty}, released_qty = #{releasedQty}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
